parsed.rationale: I read this as sinus rhythm at about 60 bpm with a normal PR interval, narrow QRS complexes and prominent but broad-based T waves in V2–V4. I don't see ST elevation of 2 mm or more in two contiguous leads, and there's no ST depression in the opposite leads, so it does not meet STEMI criteria even though your team called it an acute STEMI.
